subject: Fastest air freight quote: FRA to TPE
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you quote the fastest air freight option from FRA to TPE (Taipei, TW)? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-25, and we’ll deliver it to Frankfurt airport (FRA) ourselves, so no pickup is needed.

It’s 8 pieces of automotive sensors, with a gross weight of 234 kg and a total volume of 1.61 cbm. Could you let me know the earliest arrival you can offer and the all-in price in EUR?

Please attach the offer as a PDF to your reply, as our purchasing department needs it for filing. Thanks for checking!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG
